narrative.overview: Warm editorial surfaces and a complete sculpted paper atlas. The homepage carries the full Meridian world; shared navigation, footer, and consent carry the identity. Existing tool-page bodies retain their working dark layouts and previous typography.
keyCharacteristics: Playfair Display headlines with DM Sans interface text
Quiet dividers and subtle optional motion

rules.name: Motion access
rules.body: Respect reduced motion, expose Pause motion, and pause the atlas when hidden or outside the viewport.

dos: Preserve visible focus and descriptive field labels.
Document the actual scope of the Meridian rollout.
donts: Do not place the atlas inside an opaque raised card.
Do not claim legacy tool bodies have already migrated.
Do not add unsupported marketing claims.
